integrity: All six printed factors are reconstructed over GF(3). The quotient-ring calculation gives an explicit weight-five word, and exhaustive enumeration of all 27 codewords independently establishes the exact distance and weight distribution.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects only the concrete code specified in Example 4.1. It does not by itself refute the paper's general minimum-distance theorem, and it makes no claim about the other examples.
title: Example 4.1 generates a ternary \([21,3,5]\) code, not \([21,3,6]\)
